contracts.name: cognition_spawn_turn_worker
contracts.description: Delegate heavy work to a background turn worker (web/Grapheme execution, memory rituals). Returns immediately; the worker runs tools with a focused policy, then a synthesis pass delivers the final user-facing answer. Intents: memory.avec_calibrate | memory.context | research | general. Optional manuscript_id loads a YAML specialty (voice, tool allowlist, identity pins, OpenShell/skill tools). Manuscript spec.worker.stage_role selects a StageRoutingMatrix route (extractor, verifier, …); spec.worker.model_hint overrides provider/model. Spawn-time stage_role/model_hint win over manuscript defaults. Prefer omitting model_hint (or set model_hint=auto) so workshop StageRoutingMatrix / host preferences choose provider+model. Only pass provider:model when the user explicitly asked for that combo. Bare model ids infer the provider when unambiguous; otherwise they inherit the host turn provider — never the process default. Use manuscript_id=echo-skill or openshell-researcher for sandbox script execution. Put resolved capability/module/op and any host evidence into task — workers do not see parent chat.

intent.description: Worker profile: memory.avec_calibrate | memory.context | research | general

manuscript_id.description: Optional YAML specialty (voice, tools, worker intent, spec.worker.stage_role, spec.worker.model_hint).

model_hint.description: Optional. Prefer omit or 'auto' to use user stage-routing / host prefs. Only set provider:model when explicitly requested (e.g. deepseek:deepseek-v4-flash).

task.description: Focused task for the worker: capability id, module.op, URLs, and constraints. Include what the host already resolved so the worker does not rediscover.

user_ack.description: Short message for the user while the worker runs

contracts.name: cognition_tool_history_detail
contracts.description: Full tool-run detail for one session slice (slice_id=turn:N from summary or [MEDOUSA_TOOL_SLICES]). Optional tool_round for a single round's receipts.

contracts.name: cognition_tool_history_summary
contracts.description: High-level tool-history slices for recent session turns. Use after reading [MEDOUSA_TOOL_SLICES] at turn start when you need to verify what already ran. Returns slice_id values (turn:N) for detail drill-down.

keyword.description: Optional keyword filter on slice line / goal / outcomes

session_id.description: Session id (defaults to active turn session)

tool_filter.description: Optional substring filter on tool names

contracts.name: cognition_tools_discover
contracts.description: Unlock a tool domain for this session and return its catalog. Host: memory + vault auto-unlock at session start; environment auto-unlocks on UI-capable clients (Home). Other host domains: catalog, runtime, history, identity, skill, overlay, environment. Worker domains: execute, discover, memory, vault, openshell, scripts. Bootstrap tools stay visible without discover.

lane.description: Surface lane (default auto from active turn scope)

list_only.description: If true, return catalog without unlocking

session_id.description: Session id (defaults to active turn session)

contracts.name: cognition_turn_begin_work
contracts.description: Enter the bound workshop for multi-tool execution (environment/canvas, components, vault writes). Provide a short principal-facing message and a concrete goal for the workshop executor. Host turn ends with the ack; synthesis delivers on the same thread when the workshop finishes.

goal.description: Focused execution task for the bound workshop (tools, surfaces, constraints)

intent.description: Optional worker profile: general | research (default general)

message.description: Short principal-facing ack before workshop execution

contracts.name: cognition_turn_checkpoint
contracts.description: Share a substantive mid-task update with the principal and hand the turn back to them. The conversation is not over — you may continue after they reply. Use when tool work produced real progress but you are not done (not a final answer). Prefer this over streaming long interim prose that the runtime may loop on.

awaiting.description: Optional: what you need from the principal before more tool work (decision, confirmation, missing detail)

message.description: Principal-facing update: what you did, what you found, and what happens next or what you need from them

reason.description: Optional short note for logs (not shown to the principal)

contracts.name: cognition_turn_finish
contracts.description: Deliver the complete principal-facing final answer now and end this turn immediately. Use it as an explicit hard stop after tool work; synthesis-bound workers require it for direct pass-through, while principal-facing turns may also commit after two consecutive non-tool responses. Mid-task handoffs use cognition_turn_checkpoint.

message.description: Complete principal-facing final answer for this turn

reason.description: Optional short note for logs (not shown to the user)

contracts.name: cognition_turn_prepare_final
contracts.description: Deprecated — prefer cognition_turn_finish with the complete answer. Workshop workers may still call this; host turns should use cognition_turn_update_user for quick status, cognition_turn_begin_work before heavy work, and cognition_turn_finish to commit.

reason.description: Optional short note for logs (not shown to the user)

contracts.name: cognition_turn_propose_mode
contracts.description: Propose switching Medousa's mode for the current chat. Use Coder only when repository inspection, edits, commands, or tests would materially help; programming explanations stay in General. The runtime applies the user's auto-accept/expiry policy and never expands authority from this tool alone.

reason.description: Short user-facing reason this mode better fits the work

task_id.description: Required for task scope; use the active undertaking/work id when relevant

contracts.name: cognition_turn_request_more_rounds
contracts.description: Request additional tool rounds when the current budget is too tight. Pauses until the principal approves or denies. Include reason and progress summary.

progress_summary.description: What is done and what remains

reason.description: Why the current budget is insufficient

requested_rounds.description: How many additional model/tool rounds you need

contracts.name: cognition_turn_update_user
contracts.description: Tell the principal what you are doing right now — retries, quick course-corrections, "pulling schemas", "one sec". Call in the same model round as your next tool. Does not end the turn. Prefer this over naked chat prose (prose without tools fights the turn loop). For heavy/long-running work starting, use cognition_turn_begin_work instead.

contracts.name: cognition_turn_worker_cancel
contracts.description: Mark a pending or running turn worker as cancelled (best-effort; in-flight worker may still finish).

contracts.name: cognition_turn_worker_status
contracts.description: List or fetch status of background turn workers. On an active host turn, omit session_id to use the current session.

contracts.name: cognition_ui_build
contracts.description: Build a streaming interactive Liquid UI body with atomic verbs that chain. Prefer markdown embeds (```card``` / ```carousel``` / ```actions``` / {{icon:}}) for ordinary structured chat answers; use this tool when you need a multi-step scene session. Preferred over cognition_ui_scene — you never invent layout trees. Call verb=begin first; each response returns handles + next[] for the following call. Verbs: begin, set_prose, add_section, add_card, add_actions, done. Pass parent= from a prior handles.* id. Runtime expands verbs into scene ops.

parent.description: Parent handle from a previous response (bodyId, sectionId, …).

surface_id.description: Optional surface id for begin (defaults to chat:turn:<turnId>).

verb.description: Atomic builder verb. Chain begin → add_* / set_* → done.

contracts.name: cognition_ui_present
contracts.description: Present an HTML artifact in chat (inline card, side panel, or fullscreen) when the connected client advertises supports_ui_artifacts. Persist workflow: publish HTML here, then persist=true + surface_id (custom surface only) + component_id + slot to pin on the canvas. For first-time publish only — use cognition_artifact_write to revise an existing artifact. Canvas widgets: use MedousaStore (not localStorage); get/set/delete are async — await them in async handlers. inline: compact preview card. panel/fullscreen: use a transparent outer page background (no hard-coded #000 body); center content up to ~900px wide. Use height only for inline preview cap.

height.description: Optional inline max height hint in pixels (default ~360)

html.description: HTML fragment or document. For panel/fullscreen prefer transparent outer background; avoid full-page black fills. Card layouts up to ~900px centered are ideal. Persisted canvas widgets: use MedousaStore (not localStorage); await MedousaStore.get/set/delete — see cognition_environment_wiki(topic=artifact_runtime).

persist.description: When true, also upsert a presentation component on the environment canvas

presentation.description: How Home should render the artifact

slot.description: Slot zone for persisted component (default main)

surface_id.description: Target custom surface id for persisted component (required when persist=true; never builtin home/chat)

title.description: Short label shown in the artifact header/chip

contracts.name: cognition_ui_scene
contracts.description: Author a native, streamable scene (structure-then-fill) when the client advertises supports_ui_artifacts. Preferred over cognition_ui_present for interactive UI — the model composes typed nodes, not HTML. Emit ops in the scene-op JSON shape; go bones-first: send a plan_layout with skeleton slots, then follow up with fill_slot batches (call again in the same turn) so structure paints before content streams in. Keep each call small (plan_layout first, then 1–3 fill_slot ops per follow-up) — ops must be valid JSON. Ops: plan_layout, fill_slot, patch_props, set_binding, set_fill_state, precompute, remove. Each op is an object with a string op field; nodes carry id (stable reconciliation key), type (archetype), and props.

ops.description: Ordered scene operations. Each item is an object with a string op field (plan_layout, fill_slot, patch_props, set_binding, set_fill_state, precompute, remove). Keep batches small — plan_layout first, then fill_slot in follow-up calls.

surface_id.description: Optional scene surface id. Defaults to the chat turn surface.

contracts.name: cognition_utility_day_of_week
contracts.description: Return weekday for a YYYY-MM-DD date, or for today when date is omitted.

contracts.name: cognition_utility_time_now
contracts.description: Return current time in UTC and local timezone, including weekday and unix timestamp.

contracts.name: cognition_utility_uuid
contracts.description: Generate UUID helper values for correlation, trace, and idempotency keys.

contracts.name: cognition_vault_delete
contracts.description: Soft-delete a vault markdown note (moves to .trash). Use after confirming the path with list/read.

path.description: Relative vault note path to delete

contracts.name: cognition_vault_grep
contracts.description: Search inside a vault note (literal case-insensitive match with line numbers). Use cognition_vault_search to discover notes; use grep for surgical edits.

contracts.name: cognition_vault_list
contracts.description: List vault notes (path + title + semantic tags). Optional tag filter (match-all).

semantic_tags.description: Indexed-style tag filter (match-all), aligned with Locus tags

tag_prefix.description: Filter notes with tags sharing this prefix

contracts.name: cognition_vault_move
contracts.description: Move/rename a vault note to a new relative path. Creates parent folders as needed and removes the source note.

contracts.name: cognition_vault_read
contracts.description: Read a vault note body (budget-capped).

contracts.name: cognition_vault_search
contracts.description: Search vault notes by full text and/or semantic tags (match-all).

contracts.name: cognition_vault_tags
contracts.description: List semantic tags used across vault notes (shared vocabulary with Locus memory).

contracts.name: cognition_vault_write
contracts.description: Create or update a vault markdown note. Merges Locus-aligned semantic tags into frontmatter.

session_id.description: Chat session for workshop linking tags (defaults to current turn session)

contracts.name: cognition_web_search
contracts.description: Search the public web with one call. Uses configured provider preference and binding fallbacks (web.<provider>, then websearch.search). For deep reports use mode=research_report.

mode.description: search = provider-native web lookup; research_* = websearch facade pipelines

provider.description: Optional web provider id (duckduckgo, google, tavily, …). Defaults to capabilities.toml [web_search].preferred_provider or MEDOUSA_WEB_SEARCH_PROVIDER

try_fallbacks.description: Try lower-priority bindings when the preferred provider fails

contracts.name: cognition_workshop_steer
contracts.description: Forward a principal steer message into the active bound workshop for this session. Use when the operator adds guidance while workshop execution is in flight.

message.description: Steer text for the bound workshop

contracts.name: artifacts_fetch
contracts.title: Fetch artifact
contracts.description: Fetch an artifact by id (optional session_id).

contracts.name: artifacts_list
contracts.title: List artifacts
contracts.description: List workshop artifacts.

contracts.name: calendar_list
contracts.title: List calendar events
contracts.description: List calendar events in a time range for the bound workshop.

contracts.name: vault_list
contracts.title: List vault notes
contracts.description: List notes under the bound workshop vault (paths only).

contracts.name: vault_read
contracts.title: Read vault note
contracts.description: Read a vault markdown note by relative path.

contracts.name: vault_search
contracts.title: Search vault
contracts.description: Grep/search vault note bodies.
